policy.generation: greedy, one beam, repetition penalty 1, tokenizer EOS
policy.scoring: deterministic_local_v1; unresolved counts wrong; no judge
policy.spatial_policy: fixed longest-side downsample, rounded to patch grid
policy.temporal_sampling: uniform over entire clip, both endpoints; no max_frames

definitions.primary_rate: sum(tokens) / sum(source video duration seconds), per question evaluation
definitions.elapsed_rate: sum(tokens) / sum(saved elapsed_seconds), end-to-end worker processing rate
definitions.question_mean: arithmetic mean of individual question token/time ratios
definitions.input_text: all nonvisual input IDs, including timestamps, vision boundaries and chat template
definitions.elapsed_scope: video probing/extraction/decoding/preprocessing, transfer, generation, scoring; first question includes model loading; excludes worker startup and final summary
definitions.incomplete: no rates; observed count is latest attempt, not a union of retries
